field.label: Enable mihomo
field.help: Start the service at boot.

field.label: Log Level
field.help: Log verbosity. Use error or silent for long term operation.

field.label: Mode
field.help: rule: follow the routing rules. global: everything through the selected proxy. direct: no proxy.

field.label: Allow LAN
field.help: Let local clients use the proxy ports directly.

field.label: Domain sniffing
field.help: Recover domains from TLS SNI. Required for domain based rules on routed traffic.

field.label: Bind Address
field.help: Controller listen address. Keep 127.0.0.1 unless you really need remote access.

field.label: Port
field.help: Controller port.

field.label: Secret
field.help: Controller API secret.

field.label: TUN Mode
field.help: Route traffic into mihomo through a virtual device.

field.label: Device Name
field.help: Fixed (tun_mihomo): the firewall rules refer to this device name by hand.

field.label: Stack
field.help: Fixed (gvisor): the combination verified on FreeBSD.

field.label: Automatic Route
field.help: Take over the default route. Without working proxy nodes this cuts the network off.

field.label: Strict Route
field.help: Keep the TUN device above other default routes.

field.label: MTU
field.help: Device MTU.

field.label: DNS Module
field.help: Let mihomo resolve DNS itself (required for fake-ip).

field.label: Listen Address
field.help: DNS listen address, e.g. 127.0.0.1:1053.

field.label: Enhanced Mode
field.help: fake-ip returns synthetic addresses, redir-host returns real ones.

field.label: DNS over IPv6
field.help: Answer AAAA records. Turn off if the tunnel only carries IPv4.

field.label: DNS upstream (YAML)
field.help: YAML fragment relative to the dns: block: default-nameserver / nameserver / proxy-server-nameserver / direct-nameserver / nameserver-policy / respect-rules. Do not include the dns: line. Empty removes these keys.

field.label: IPv6 handling
field.help: Let the core handle IPv6. Off = IPv6 traffic stays on the normal route (current design).

field.label: Subscription URL
field.help: Subscription URL, stored in the plugin environment file.

field.label: Access Secret
field.help: Secret written into the generated configuration.

field.label: Auto update
field.help: Create a scheduled task for the subscription update.

field.label: Interval
field.help: How often the scheduled task runs.
